name: Battering Door
disable: DC 30 Diplomacy check or DC 30 Occultism check (master) to soothe the psychic impressions or DC 28 Thievery check (expert) to jam the door open

items.name: Batter Trespasser
items.text:
Trigger A living creature passes through the door

---

Effect The door slams into the triggering creature, dealing 4d10+26 bludgeoning damage (DC 28 basic Reflex save save).
